mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sql_task_backfill_batch WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT id,task_id,start_date,end_date,status,total_count,submitted_count,succeeded_count,failed_count,max_concurrency,parameter_values,requested_by,create_time,update_time FROM sql_task_backfill_batch WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_backfill_batch WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sql_task_backfill_batch SET status=#{to},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{from}

UPDATE sql_task_backfill_batch b SET submitted_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_backfill_item i WHERE i.batch_id=b.id AND i.execution_id IS NOT NULL),succeeded_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_backfill_item i WHERE i.batch_id=b.id AND i.status='SUCCEEDED'),failed_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_backfill_item i WHERE i.batch_id=b.id AND i.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')),status=CASE WHEN b.status='PAUSED' THEN 'PAUSED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sql_task_backfill_item i WHERE i.batch_id=b.id AND i.status IN ('PENDING','CLAIMED','SUBMITTED','RUNNING')) THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sql_task_backfill_item i WHERE i.batch_id=b.id AND i.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sql_task_backfill_item i WHERE i.batch_id=b.id AND i.status='SUCCEEDED') THEN 'PARTIAL_FAILED' ELSE 'FAILED' END ELSE 'SUCCEEDED' END,update_time=NOW() WHERE b.id=#{id}
